scope: 3 learned circumflex roots x4 opening wrappers x5 right contexts x2 choices x3 casing variants. Cursor-aware DocumentEditor, snapshot staleness, forget/relearn, exact replacement, continued typing and undo.
limits: Core cursor-aware editor adapter; not UIKit cursor gestures or physical typing.
Snapshot rejection and fresh candidate revocation are checked through core APIs; document-identity gating remains a separate UI contract.
Continued typing is tested at the retained caret before existing right text; no assertion that the caret advances over existing whitespace.
